name: Millhaven inn, well and crossing

sensoryProfile.sight: Cobbled crossing with a well at its dead middle, four roads running into the dark; the inn at the crossing with an outside stair up to a gallery over the door, a yard with a wall round it, a taproom with a settle and a table under the window, a kitchen, a cellar behind the bar via a trapdoor with an iron ring; a horseshoe points-down over the lintel; a handcart tipped at the mouth of the south road.
sensoryProfile.sound: The inn sign creaking; the door knocking against its frame; the well windlass's long iron squeal; the race below the bridge; boot and hoof ring.
sensoryProfile.smell: Cold hearth-ash, old beer, lantern tallow; the cellar smells of spilled beer gone sour and apples going soft in straw.
sensoryProfile.touch: Well rope damp and green-slick; cobbles frosted white round the mage's hand; staff buzzing in a hand.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: The most exposed place in the village; the loudest ground the mage reads before the storehouse; the party's overnight base.

establishedFacts.fact: The gallery over the inn door looks along all four roads at once and has a roof behind it; Lyriel covered the north and west roads from it; Sylvanas held the corner on the night watch.
The inn yard has a wall round it; horses were put there nose to the wall; a mounting block stands by the horse lines.
The cellar behind the bar is empty of people; the contamination there reads 'worse than the well'.
The well rope is damp and slick with green; the bucket water is contaminated, thinner than in the doe.
The crossing read: all four lines coming in are heavy; two (north) are late by distance; east does not lag; west could not be heard (drowned). No clean source-or-sink answer.

The party spent the night in the inn: the girl and Neral on the taproom settle; the mage in the yard on the mounting block; the watch on the gallery and yard gate. Sylvanas wrote the dispatch at the table under the taproom window.

charactersPresentHere: the old carter (at the crossing, leaving)

eventsHere.event: Horses spook at the crossing; first sweep; well read; the mage's hand tears on the frosted cobbles; horses re-checked clean in the yard; night watch on the gallery.

Dispatch written in the taproom; Neral, the girl and the fourth ranger leave from the yard and ride north past the inn sign; the carter's wagon passes the well and goes north through the crossing; the four ride out over the bridge southward.
